neighbours.label: ' show' as a verb of displaying a quality (to show compassion), and Spanish asemeja
fire: The goal of a good life is to show mercy.
Their real duty is to show kindness to strangers.
The point of the ritual is to show respect.
Su carácter se asemeja a las montañas.
All of this is meant to show loyalty to the king.
El clima se asemeja al de la costa.
The purpose of the gift is to show gratitude.
Her job is to show patience with every child.
quiet: The goal of a good life is hard to define.
Their real duty is to clean the rooms for strangers.
The point of the ritual is lost on me.
Su carácter es duro como las montañas.
All of this is meant for the king.
El clima es seco en la costa.
The purpose of the gift is unclear to us.
Her job is to teach music to every child.
